# octoreview-php

> Official PHP SDK for Octoreview: multi-tenant reviews, ratings and review media. Part of the octoverse family, modelled on octonomy. Status: bootstrapped; release
> line 1 in progress.

Gates: `make check` (fast, toolchain only) and `make release-check` (full). `make help` lists
every target.
